purposes.title: Train AI on your content
purposes.allows: It may use your streams, videos, voice, chat, posts, pictures and code to train or improve its AI.
purposes.cannot_undo: A model it already trained keeps what it learned.

purposes.title: Use your content
purposes.allows: It may read and use your streams, videos, posts and other content for its own features.
purposes.cannot_undo: A copy it already made stays with the app.
